answer: A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit. The design leans on reputation decay for idle identities, forfeited on duplicate submission. Work waits on the ledge until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the ridge of the next round. Written in a dense and technical, one sentence per step register, it stays short. Reaching the mesa of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys.
